terms_body: By using this app, you agree to provide accurate information and to use the platform only for donating and requesting blood. The platform is committed to protecting your personal data and not sharing it except when necessary. The app administration reserves the right to modify services or suspend accounts that violate the terms. By creating an account, you agree to these terms and conditions.
role_switch_warning: When you submit a request for blood, the "I am a donor" status will be automatically cancelled and you will not appear in the active donors list. You can reactivate it later after your request ends.
accept_terms: I agree to the terms and conditions
confirm_logout: Are you sure you want to log out?
confirm_cancel_request: Are you sure you want to cancel this request?
confirm_accept_request: Are you sure you want to accept this request?
get_well_soon: We wish you a speedy recovery
donation_life_chance: Every blood donation is a new chance for life
hadith_believer_affair: «How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for his affairs are all good, and this is not for anyone except the believer. If something good happens to him, he is grateful, and that is good for him. If something bad happens to him, he is patient, and that is good for him»
no_requests_description: No blood donation requests were found in your area. Please check back later or enable notifications to be informed when new requests are available.
thanks_for_donating: Thank you for your willingness to donate. Your contribution may save a life.
profile_data_notice: This request data is filled automatically from your profile. Please update your data if anything has changed.
request_form_description: Enter your request data accurately to help us find compatible donors for the required blood type as soon as possible.
confirm_accept_request_msg: Are you sure you want to accept this request?
accept_request_notice: By accepting the request, the requester will be notified that you are ready to donate blood.
accept_request_thanks: Thank you for your humanitarian contribution. The requester has been notified of your readiness to donate, and you will be contacted when needed.
donors_section_description: This section shows donors who have agreed to your request and can help provide the required blood.
donors_completed_desc: The blood donation request has been fully covered
logout_message: Are you sure you want to log out?
logout_see_you: We look forward to seeing you again. Thank you for contributing to the blood donation community.
donor_card_motivation: Every donation brings you closer to a new level and increases your impact in saving lives, because continuous giving deserves appreciation.
donor_card_explanation: The donor card is your interactive profile within the platform, showing your giving level, donation count, points earned, and achievements throughout your humanitarian journey. Earn points through donation, commitment, and participation, and rise through five levels that reflect your impact on the community.
appointments_description: Manage and track all your blood donation appointments easily, and view details of upcoming and past appointments.
no_appointments_description: You have no scheduled donation appointments. You can browse available requests and book a new appointment to help those in need.
donation_record_description: Review all your previous blood donations and track your humanitarian contributions and their impact.
cancel_request_notice: Cancelling will notify the requester that you are not ready to donate blood.
search_patients: Search for a patient or hospital...
quran_verse: وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا أَحْيَا النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا
hadith_relief: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا، نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
quran_saving_life: مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنَّهُ مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا أَحْيَا النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا
